ITEM 1 | Pale orange-pink piece with flaky, slightly moist surface and light golden-brown edges, one fillet-like portion about 7 x 5 cm and roughly 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the top of the plate with a light herb flecking and a glossy coating | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens, mixed leaves with crinkled and flat shapes, some wilted, with a slightly glossy dressing sheen, spread across the center of the plate about 13 x 11 cm and up to 3 cm deep | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green cubed pieces, firm and smooth-skinned, cut into chunks about 2.5 x 2.5 x 2 cm, clustered on the lower left edge of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Thin pale cream shredded strands, fine and slightly curled, scattered over the greens and fish, dry-looking with no sheen | 12
ITEM 5 | Small bright red and orange cherry tomato halves, glossy and moist, about 1.5 cm across, two or three pieces on the salad | 15
ITEM 6 | Scattered small golden-brown seed or nut bits, dry and crunchy-looking, sprinkled among the greens | 6
ITEM 7 | Dark brownish-purple shreds, slightly wilted and matte, clustered at the lower edge of the greens about 3 x 2 cm | 8
ITEM 8 | Clear-to-pale yellow glossy dressing film visible as a light sheen on the greens and plate surface, thin and spread | 5
